info.title: robi
info.description: I/O behind the Robi loop: model providers and the local session API

409.description: Chat session is running, awaiting approval, or has nothing to compact

404.description: Chat session or message is missing

204.description: The file or hunk was approved or rejected

200.description: Capped streams stored for a compressed tool result

parameters.name: event_types
parameters.description: Repeated. When non-empty, only these CloudEvents types are sent.

parameters.name: session_id
parameters.description: When set, only envelopes whose subject is this session.

parameters.name: workspace_id
parameters.description:
When set without `session_id`, every session frame is delivered. Index
and MCP frames are limited to this workspace. A `session_id` query
still derives the workspace from the session row.

200.description: CloudEvents JSON as server-sent events. Each frame is `id`, `event`, and `data`.
Tool-capable models the provider can drive

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Repeat to read several keys in one request.

200.description: Settings in request order. An unset key with a default is stored, then returned. An unset key with no default has a null value. Secret values are omitted.
Setting. An unset key with a default is stored, then returned. An unset key with no default has a null value. Secret values are omitted.

204.description: Setting removed. The next read inherits.

200.description: Workspace already open for this root
Markdown files in this workspace, gitignore respected

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: A natural language question, or a literal string when engine is ripgrep. Required, non-blank.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many hits to return. Default 10, maximum 20.

parameters.name: engine
parameters.description: semantic (default) or ripgrep. Anything else is 400.

200.description: Ranked markdown hits with the engine and the index state they came from

400.description: `q` is missing or blank, `limit` is out of range, or `engine` is unknown

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Workspace-relative path to a markdown file

400.description: Not a markdown file, or not UTF-8

404.description: No such file, or a path outside the workspace

400.description: state is not paused or running

200.description: Configured MCP servers and connection status

204.description: This workspace's MCP servers are starting; other workspaces are closed

200.description: MCP JSON files as stored on disk

context_window.description: The model's advertised context window, in tokens.

ChatImage.description: One image a user attached, referenced by id. The bytes live in the store.

compaction.description: `true` on a compaction summary. Omitted on every other message.

images.description:
Images the user attached. `id` is an image in the session blob file; fetch the bytes
via `GET /chat_sessions/{id}/images/{image_id}`.

oneOf.description: Present when the provider reported tokens for this model turn.

allow_hosts.description: Hosts this session may fetch without another approval card.

has_pending_agent.description: True while this session's actor is running. Read from memory, not the database.

title.description:
Absent until the model names the chat session after the first turn, or a
create/rename supplies one.

turn_display.description: Display summary of the latest turn: `idle`, `pending`, `awaiting_approval`, or `failed`.

ChatSkill.description: A skill loaded because the user wrote `@id`.

ChatSubagent.description: The child run attached to a parent `delegate` call.

started_ms.description: Unix time in milliseconds when the child started.

ChatSubagentStep.description: One child tool call shown inside a delegate card.

original_id.description: Set when compression stored the capped streams for this call.

oneOf.description: Child tool calls for a `delegate` run. Absent on every other tool.

ChatUsage.description: Token counts for one model turn. `input` is the prompt size, not a session total.

mode.description: `ask`, `plan`, or `agent`. Omitted starts in agent mode.

oneOf.description: Per-mode session overrides. Omitted keys inherit that mode's setting.

title.description:
Omitted, null, or empty leaves the chat session unnamed. The model writes a
title after the first turn. Longer than
[`CHAT_SESSION_TITLE_MAX_CHARS`](crate::domain::chat_session::service::CHAT_SESSION_TITLE_MAX_CHARS)
is rejected.

root.description: Absolute or relative directory. Stored as its canonical path.

decision.description: `approve` keeps the change. `reject` puts the baseline lines back.

hunk_id.description: One hunk. Omitted applies `decision` to the whole file.

reason.description: Shown to the model when `decision` is `reject`. Omitted uses a default.

score.description: Reciprocal rank fusion score. Higher is better.

snippet.description: The chunk's opening text, cut at 500 bytes on a character boundary.

title.description:
The heading chain of the section this chunk belongs to, joined by `.`
(`Install.Overview`). Empty when the page did not parse into sections.

index.description:
The index state the hits were taken from. For `semantic`, anything but
`ready` means the corpus was incomplete, so the hits may be too.
`ripgrep` does not start the index and does not treat this as partial.

query.description: The trimmed query that was run.

McpConfig.description: The MCP JSON files for one workspace. Text is the file on disk. Secrets are not resolved.

project_enabled.description: True when the stored project hash matches the file's current bytes.

McpServer.description: One MCP server this workspace is configured to use. Header and env values are omitted.

icon.description: `https` URL or `data:image` URI from the server handshake.

ModeOverrideBody.description: Model and effort for one mode. Absent keys inherit the setting.

ModeOverridePatch.description:
One mode's model and effort patch.

`None` means the key was omitted. `Some(None)` clears it. `Some(Some)` sets it.

model.description: Catalog model id. Null clears the session override.

reasoning_effort.description: `low`, `medium`, or `high`. Null clears the session override.

ModelConfigBody.description: Stored per-mode overrides. An absent mode inherits its setting.

ModelConfigPatch.description: Per-mode session overrides. An omitted mode stays as stored.

baseline.description: Body before this session's first change of the path.

current.description: Body on disk now. Empty when the file is gone.

new_start.description: 0-based index of the first current line.

old_start.description: 0-based index of the first baseline line.

secret.description:
When true, the value is written to the secrets file and later reads
over HTTP omit it.

value.description: `null` when the key is unset and has no default. Omitted when the stored value is a secret.

allow_hosts.description: Hostnames `web_fetch` may call without another approval. A present list replaces the stored list.

mode.description: `ask`, `plan`, or `agent`. Omitted leaves the stored mode.

oneOf.description: Merge into the stored per-mode overrides. A null key clears that override. An omitted key stays.

path_allow_read.description: Extra read-allow regexes, appended after the built-in list. The furthest match wins; at the same end byte, more literals win.

path_allow_write.description: Regexes. Ranked the same way as read allows. A parent match does not outrank a more specific write deny.

path_deny_read.description: Regexes matched against the workspace-relative path. A match denies a read.

path_deny_write.description: Regexes matched against the workspace-relative path. A match denies a write.

title.description: When set, replaces the title. Omitted leaves the stored title alone.
